periods.title: Ledger periods
periods.lead: Lock a month once it is reconciled. Nothing can be posted into a locked month or any month before it, so its figures never change. Corrections go in as reversals in an open month. A second finance user approves every lock and every reopening.
periods.caption: Months of the ledger, newest first

pending.period_lock: A lock is waiting for a second finance user.
pending.period_unlock: A request to reopen it is waiting for a second finance user.

periods.unlockHint: A second finance user reads this before they approve. Up to 500 characters.
periods.lateAdjustments: A capture or refund dated in a locked month counts in the first open month after it, marked as a late adjustment.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: Locking or reopening a month, and a manual entry above ₹{threshold}, wait here until a second finance user approves. You can't approve your own request. Approving asks you to confirm it's you again.
approvals.requestedEntry: Your entry is above the approval limit, so it waits here for a second finance user. It is posted once they approve it.
approvals.noDecided: No request has been decided yet.
approvals.overdue: Its time has run out. It closes tonight, and can be asked for again.
approvals.ownRequest: Another finance user has to approve or reject this.

results.lock_requested: Your request to lock the month is waiting for a second finance user.
results.unlock_requested: Your request to reopen the month is waiting for a second finance user.

errors.forbidden: Only FOA finance staff can do this.
errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason of up to 500 characters.
errors.not_pending: That request has already been decided.
errors.self_approval: You asked for this, so another finance user has to decide it.
errors.not_requester: Only the finance user who asked can withdraw it.
errors.request_expired: Its time ran out. Ask again if it is still needed.
errors.request_pending: A request for that month is already waiting.
errors.period_locked: That month is already locked, or is before a locked month.
errors.earlier_period_open: Lock the earlier open months first, oldest first.
errors.later_period_locked: Reopen the later locked months first, newest first.
errors.invalid_description: The entry's description no longer fits. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.invalid_memo: A memo no longer fits. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.unknown_account: An account in the entry no longer exists. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.inactive_account: An account in the entry has been deactivated. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.unbalanced: The entry doesn't balance. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.too_few_lines: The entry needs at least two lines. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.too_many_lines: The entry has too many lines. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.non_positive_amount: The entry has an amount that isn't above zero. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.missing_account: The entry has a line without an account. Reject it and enter it again.
errors.invalid_source_type: The entry can't be posted. Reject it and enter it again.
